assessment_objectives.objective: the legal and regulatory obligations associated with the cessation and transition of third-party services (e.g., data protection, breach notification, regulatory notification and cross-border transfer requirements) are identified and documented.

the contractual obligations associated with the cessation and transition of third-party services (e.g., notice periods, transition assistance, data return and destruction, and confidentiality survival clauses) are identified and documented.
the licensing obligations associated with the cessation and transition of third-party services (e.g., license transfers, terminations and continued use rights) are identified and documented.
the records retention obligations associated with the cessation and transition of third-party services are identified and documented, including which party retains the records and for how long.
each identified compliance obligation is assigned to accountable personnel and its fulfillment is tracked to completion.
